integrity: Complete theorem, proof, self-review, verification report and standard-library verifier are embedded in the enclosing package with exact byte counts and SHA-256 digests.
scientific_limitations: Ferrers incidence valuations on finite two-agent grids; ordinary set-based modal successor semantics, one propositional atom, no graded modalities. Finite tests supplement the inductive proof; literature searches cannot certify absolute novelty.
title: Ferrers-boundary parity law for the full modal-depth spectrum of two-agent grids
